title: Amazing
text: The experience was absolutely amazing.   Francisco shared so much knowledge.  We left our bag on the tour bus and  Francisco went out of his way to return it to us.   Amazing tour and an amazing guide!  Thank you Francisco!
author: Caylin_S

title: Good but could be Better!
text:
The Viator ticket only included the entrance to the monastery, I wish the offer the options to go up to see the Virgin, the museum or the choir 
We arrived at 10 am and our ticket was for 1045 am we spent only 15 minutes inside the church is not enough time to enjoy, there was a mass at 11 so the church is closed during that time. So i bought my own tickets and went back to the church
author: Maria_F
